titles.title: ลูกศิษย์ที่รัก

description:
Han Shin-woo met Ga-hyun, a female college student, at a club where she went with her colleagues for a college graduation party.  
Two people who meet and date each other in a relationship that saved her in an embarrassing situation.  
Shin-woo looks young and naive, and Ga-hyun falls in love with Han Shin-woo's wonderful appearance.

And March.  
Shinwoo will be in charge of third grade homeroom at Daehan High School, where he was appointed for the first time, Jin Ga-hyun, class president of first grade class in third grade... ...?

"Maybe. Do you have an older sister?

Shin-woo asked with the feeling of catching straws.

"... No."

Gahyun's voice was mixed with tears.
